description.value: Award-winning estate winery on Lakeshore Road overlooking Lake Okanagan, known for cool-climate Pinot Noir and sustainable farming practices including cover crops and Scottish Highland cattle. Features the Home Block Restaurant with a wine-first menu showcasing Okanagan produce, plus guided wine tastings and vineyard tours.
